committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 14 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend rose to $141.86 from $102.10 with clicks up to 23 from 17, but conversions are still 0 for the week. Post-restart clicks since 8 Sept sit at 21, nowhere near the 150-click stop-loss threshold.
Rank lost share is 76.6% against budget lost of only 17%, so ad rank is the constraint, not budget. Impression share is 10% for the week, consistent with a small, deliberately scoped campaign.

/ai-automation-agency.html pulled 18 of the week's 38 sessions and led all landing pages, while /simpro-xero-integration.html shows 148 impressions and 0 clicks at position 20 in Search Console, suggesting the page is not matching what those searchers expect.

AI Assistant sessions are 0 for a second straight week and LinkedIn is also 0, worth checking whether Chris's posts are untagged given AI referrer data undercounts anyway. Organic search ticked up to 8 sessions from 3, still a small number.

actions.text: Source logo and image assets and draft keyword-matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict, not before it, so lead counts only reflect confirmed submissions.
Update RSA description D1, which still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, to match the current site stats.
